commit.description: A full commit id (40 hexadecimal digits).

conflicts.description: The paths left with conflict markers (relative to the repository root). The files are open to edit; eludite.git.stage on a file marks it resolved.

generation.description: The status generation after the call: it grows whenever the repository's status changes (the watcher saw `.git/index`, `.git/HEAD`, `.git/refs/` or the working tree change, or a command changed them). eludite.git.status answers with the same number; an answer with an older generation is stale.
